content.content: 1. Necessity: the missing-operand refusal needs the refusal contract for the id-taking verbs it covers — without it, refusing an id-less invocation is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: No-id is where the refusal contract meets the id-taking verbs' argument surface; the gate keeps the use sound without testing arity itself.
